data.verdict: DERIVED (structural iff, no two-row cap): tr(Delta_S)(z) has DEFINITE bar-parity if and only if z satisfies the FULL-BAR condition bar(z) = z - h, and where it does the parity is ODD. chi^(3)(Delta_S) is bar-odd exactly; g is bar-even exactly on full-bar and can never be bar-odd. CONSEQUENCE: z = 1 and z_C are excluded a SECOND time, by bar-parity, with no appeal to the cap and hence none to the owner ruling. This CORRECTS this session's own Step 10 framing ('the block is a ruling, not an impossibility') -- that is right about the CAP and wrong as a statement about the exclusion as a whole. It also explains decayLadder_zC_threeRow_ne_zero: z_C is bar-EVEN, a DIFFERENT condition from full-bar. PREMISE for the application, stated not smuggled: 'the decay trace must have definite bar-parity', which is corpus-standard (fig8Trace_im_odd, ZBarParity) but is NOT proved here. LIMIT: the full-bar family is z_D + (any bar-even function) and contains z = q too, so this narrows the fibre to full-bar -- it does not pin a unique z.
